datasetVersion.termsOfAccess: Requests for reuse of the data must be within the scope of the purposes of this study as described in the informed consent form: This study aims to assess the accuracy and precision of a developed eye tracker, including its ability to measure head orientation. The goal is to improve the system's range and user comfort.

fields.value: Replication Data for: GAZE AND VERGENCE MEASUREMENTS WITH STEREOSCOPIC EYE-TRACKER

dsDescriptionValue.value: Dataset containing comprehensive eye-tracking data, including pupil and corneal coordinates, point of gaze (POG) in various units, axis angles and center of rotation locations.

datasetVersion.citation: Pijpaert, Arthur, 2024, "Replication Data for: GAZE AND VERGENCE MEASUREMENTS WITH STEREOSCOPIC EYE-TRACKER", https://doi.org/10.34894/LTATFP, DataverseNL, V1
